cross_row_leads.facts: Mustang Express system consists of three segments: (1) Cougar Lateral 55 mi, (2) Mainline 178 mi, (3) Golden Triangle/Spindletop Storage Lateral 3 mi. All 42-inch diameter, system capacity 2500 MMcf/d. FID announced 10/9/2025, in-service late 2028/early 2029. System capacity figure (2500 MMcf/d) is not applicable to individual segment rows.
P7835 (Cougar Lateral) is 55 miles from Tres Palacios Storage to Katy Hub. Part of same Mustang Express system with P7836 and P7834. System-level specs (42-inch, 2500 MMcf/d) apply to all segments.
P7837 (Eiger Express) is a different project (450 mi, 42-inch, 2500 MMcf/d capacity, status proposed). Not part of Mustang Express system, though both are Permian-to-Gulf LNG feed lines.
